description: HPO terms for the 20 papa checklist items (configs/checklists/papa.json), chosen on 2026-11-15 by a Claude helper from the pinned HPO release by name and synonym search and hierarchy checks (pipeline/extract/hpo_lookup.py), D-47 (extending D-40). 'observed' is the one term a record may assert when the item is observed; null where the item is a composite no single term covers exactly (the free-text feature rows carry the specific term). 'excluded' lists every term a record may mark excluded when the item is explicitly absent. Flagged for review by Jimmy or the panel; not a pre-registered choice.

pyogenic sterile arthritis or other arth.note: Arthritis (EXACT 'Joint inflammation'); the item covers any arthritis. Sterile arthritis (HP:0040310) and Septic arthritis are descendants; HPO has no 'pyogenic arthritis' term.

pyoderma gangrenosum.note: Pyoderma gangrenosum; exact name match. Its parent Skin ulcer is broader.

acne (including cystic acne or acne cong.note: Acne is asserted when observed. It is not excluded, because in HPO Acne inversa (hidradenitis suppurativa, a separate item) is a child of Acne, so excluding Acne would also exclude hidradenitis; excluded are its other children Cystic acne and Comedonal acne. HPO has no 'acne conglobata' term. Review whether a paper's 'no acne' should exclude Acne itself.

skin or soft-tissue abscesses.note: Composite: Cutaneous abscess (EXACT 'Skin abscess'; Perianal abscess and Recurrent cutaneous abscess formation are descendants) and Subcutaneous abscess, which is not under Cutaneous abscess. Their common parent Abscess, and Sterile abscess, cover any site and are broader than the item; HPO has no soft-tissue abscess term.

sterile osteomyelitis or osteolytic bone.note: Composite: HPO has no sterile, aseptic or chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis term. Osteomyelitis (HP:0002754, EXACT 'Bone infection') covers infectious osteomyelitis and is broader than sterile osteomyelitis, so it is neither asserted for the item nor excluded; a feature row may carry it. Osteolysis (EXACT 'Osteolytic defects of bones') matches the osteolytic lesions and is excluded; it is not under Osteomyelitis.

fever.note: Fever; exact name match (Recurrent and Persistent fever are descendants).

elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ESR.note: Composite: Elevated circulating C-reactive protein concentration, Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and Elevated circulating serum amyloid A concentration. Their common parent Acute phase response is broader (it also covers ferritin, hepcidin and calcium-phosphate regulating hormones).

splenomegaly.note: Splenomegaly; exact name match (Hepatosplenomegaly is a descendant).

hepatomegaly.note: Hepatomegaly; exact name match (Hepatosplenomegaly is a descendant).

growth failure or failure to thrive.note: Composite: Growth delay (EXACT 'Growth failure') and Failure to thrive (under Decreased body weight); neither is an ancestor of the other.

hypercalprotectinemia (elevated MRP8/14).note: Elevated circulating calprotectin concentration (MRP8/14 is calprotectin); Increased fecal calprotectin level is a different finding.

inflammatory bowel disease or colitis.note: Composite: Inflammation of the large intestine (non-EXACT synonym 'Inflammatory bowel disease'; Colitis and Ulcerative colitis are descendants) and Crohn's disease, which is not under it. Their common parent Gastrointestinal inflammation is broader (esophagitis).

kidney involvement (proteinuria, hematur.note: Composite: Proteinuria, Hematuria, Nephropathy (synonym 'Kidney damage') and Nephritis (Glomerulonephritis is a descendant), none an ancestor of another. Their common parent Abnormal renal physiology is broader.
